title: Compatible-tower composition in explicit product compactifications
statement: For Noetherian B,X,Z, separated finite-type f:X→B and g:Z→B, compactifications cf,cg and finite commutative A, every bounded-below etale-origin object Q on X×B Z satisfies alpha_Q=compositionRoute_Q in the coordinates of def-pur-product-exchange-coordinate-data. There are no tensor, projection-invertibility or ambient exchange-invertibility assumptions.

source.place: Symmetry paragraph, reduction to proper maps, expanded by product-coordinate node Steps 3--8; Stacks Tags 09BN, 0E47 and 0F7J.

proof.text: Use q=pullback.snd f g, d=cg and the upper compactification (u,t), where u=(cf.baseChange g).i followed by i and t=pullback.snd cf.g cg.g. Its restriction along cg.i is isomorphic to cf.baseChange g by square; the unique projection-preserving isomorphism identifies all compactification candidate comparisons.

For a bounded-below etale antecedent apply the equality-only compatible-tower formula. Normalize exact versus total pullback and identify the open adjunct towerGamma with properOpenMate by the restriction/exchange and open-unit equations. The two open compositors agree by uniqueness of the adjoint to composite restriction; the direct-image compositor is finiteDirectImageComposition.

Transport the equality along the supplied etale-origin witness by naturality of canonical candidate comparisons, origin composition, mate and compositors, and cancel the witness isomorphism. This proves the equality on Q without any arbitrary witness selection in a definition.

theorem productCompositionCoordinateComparison
    {B X Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ B} {g : Z ⟶ B}
    [IsNoetherian B] [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (cf : Compactification f) (cg : Compactification g)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (Q : ProperOpenDerived (ULift.{u + 1} A) (pullback f g))
    (hQ : DerivedCategory.plusEtaleOrigin (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} A))
      (pullback f g) Q) :
    alpha cf cg A Q hQ = compositionRoute cf cg A Q
